title: Campus Job Fee
scenario: A campus job contact says you must pay for training materials before starting.

answers.A: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.B: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.C: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.
answers.D: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.

explanation: Campus Job Fee: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Real employers pay you; they do not charge surprise upfront fees.
